title.label: Made me keep the Iphone Duo

content.label:
I’ve always preferred Pixel phones over iPhones because of their pure Android experience and Google’s superior implementation of AI. This year, the Pixel 11 series introduced a couple of features that impressed me far more than yet another iPhone with a faster processor. Those features were Rambler and Magic Capture.

However, I recently sold my Pixel 11 Pro Fold to try out the iPhone Duo. I honestly didn’t expect to keep the Duo because I had grown tired of iOS. But given the cost of the device, I decided to give it a fair chance. That led me to search for AI apps and implementations that could replicate some of the features I loved on my Pixel.

That’s when I discovered Wispr Flow.

I don’t know which came first, Rambler or Wispr Flow, but I can tell you that Wispr Flow works just as seamlessly and impressively as Rambler. More importantly, it works beautifully on my iPhone Duo!

I’m sure the folks behind Wispr Flow aren’t in the business of selling iPhones, but they’ve managed to convince me that I can get remarkably close to the AI experience I enjoy on my Pixel while using the Duo.

Now, would this convince me to switch to a traditional slab iPhone? Absolutely not. I’m pretty tired of those devices. But on the Duo, Wispr Flow gives me a compelling reason to keep it.

I also have a Pixel 11 Pro XL that has been my primary phone, with the Duo serving as my secondary device. However, because of Wispr Flow, I’m now planning to move my primary eSIM to the Duo and make the Pixel my secondary phone. Of course, I’ll still rely on the Pixel for photography because its camera system is vastly superior.

What excites me most about this technology is that it represents one of the most practical and meaningful implementations of AI I’ve experienced.

I no longer have to spend so much time typing or staring at my screen. I can simply speak naturally, express my thoughts, stumble over words, make grammatical mistakes, and even ramble a bit. The AI takes everything I’ve said and transforms it into a clear, polished, and coherent message without losing my original intent or voice.

It’s particularly valuable when I’m on the go because it reduces the temptation to type while driving. Of course, sending messages still requires doing so safely, but the ability to dictate naturally makes a tremendous difference.

And the best part? I don’t have to spend time correcting or rewriting anything. I simply review the message and hit send.

This is the kind of AI implementation that genuinely improves everyday life. It’s not about benchmark scores, processor speeds, or flashy features that rarely get used. It’s about technology that understands what I’m trying to accomplish and makes doing it easier.

Wispr Flow is an outstanding app, and it may have just convinced a diehard Pixel enthusiast to make an iPhone his primary phone!
